segments.spoken_text: Your AI can draft the reply without making the promise.
Imagine a customer asking when something will arrive. Use a fictional request for the first test.
Give the assistant only approved facts and a clear instruction to flag anything it cannot confirm.
In this example, the draft promises tomorrow. Our approved information does not support that date.
The next step is a person checking the request, not the message going straight to the customer.
That person corrects the draft, confirms any promise, and decides whether to send it.
Keep the boundary visible: prepare, review, then send. A missing fact returns to the process owner.
Map one routine reply today. Mark the exact point where a human must decide.
